The PMOS hit W = 12 mm because gm/Id = 16 at L = 0.18 µm is near weak-inversion saturation for SKY130 pfets. I'm lowering gm/Id_p to about 12 and capping widths in code. To recover Gm for the 230 MHz bandwidth, I'm raising the NMOS gm/Id and Imain toward the power limit. Imain must stay at or below ~70 µA so power is under 170 µW at 1.98 V.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "ERC failure: PMOS W blew up (gm/Id 16 at L=0.18 near weak-inversion limit). Lower gmid_p to ~12 with tighter bounds, clamp widths, raise Imain/gmid_n to keep Gm for 230 MHz, slightly longer L for loop gain/gain accuracy."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid_n": (15.0, 10.0, 18.0),
    "L_n":    (0.2, 0.15, 0.4),
    "gmid_p": (12.0, 8.0, 14.0),
    "L_p":    (0.2, 0.15, 0.4),
    "Imain":  (64e-6, 40e-6, 68e-6),
    "Is":     (4e-6, 2e-6, 8e-6),
    "R1":     (30e3, 15e3, 80e3),
    "ratio":  (0.118, 0.110, 0.126),
    "Cc":     (2e-12, 1e-12, 4e-12),
}

def _size_capped(lut, dev, gmid, L, Id, vds, wmax=3000.0):
    g = gmid
    op = lut.size(dev, g, L, Id, vds=vds)
    while op.W > wmax and g > 6.0:
        g -= 0.5
        op = lut.size(dev, g, L, Id, vds=vds)
    return op

def design(p, lut, spec):
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 1e-12)
    vdd = 1.8
    Im = p["Imain"]; Is = p["Is"]; Cc = p["Cc"]

    # reference diode (same L, gm/Id as mirrored devices)
    mr = _size_capped(lut, "n", p["gmid_n"], p["L_n"], iref, 0.5, wmax=3000.0 * iref / Im)
    gmn_used = mr.gm_id
    mn = lut.size("n", gmn_used, p["L_n"], Im, vds=0.9)
    mp = _size_capped(lut, "p", p["gmid_p"], p["L_p"], Im, 0.9)
    Wn_main = mr.W * Im / iref
    # servo OTA
    ms_in = lut.size("n", 15.0, 0.5, Is / 2, vds=0.5, vsb=0.3)
    ms_ld = lut.size("p", 10.0, 0.5, Is / 2, vds=0.6)
    Wt_s = max(0.42, mr.W * Is / iref)

    R1 = p["R1"]; Rf = p["ratio"] * R1
    Rbig = 2e6

    n = Netlist("vin1 vin2 vout vcm vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MR", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mr)
    # main CMOS inverter stage, NMOS mirrored via Rbig, AC-coupled to inv
    n.M("MN", "vout", "ng", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wn_main, p["L_n"])
    n.R("RB", "ibias", "ng", Rbig)
    n.C("CCN", "inv", "ng", Cc)
    # PMOS: DC set by servo, AC-coupled to inv
    n.dev("MP", "vout", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.C("CCP", "inv", "pg", Cc)
    # servo 5T OTA
    n.M("MTS", "ts", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wt_s, p["L_n"])
    n.dev("MS1", "sd1", "inv", "ts", "vss", ms_in)
    n.dev("MS2", "pg", "vcm", "ts", "vss", ms_in)
    n.dev("MS3", "sd1", "sd1", "vdd", "vdd", ms_ld)
    n.dev("MS4", "pg", "sd1", "vdd", "vdd", ms_ld)
    # feedback network
    n.R("R1", "vin1", "inv", R1)
    n.R("Rf", "inv", "vout", Rf)

    # predictions
    beta = R1 / (R1 + Rf)
    kn = Cc / (Cc + mn.cgg); kp = Cc / (Cc + mp.cgg)
    Gm = kn * mn.gm + kp * mp.gm
    gout = mn.gds + mp.gds + 1.0 / (R1 + Rf)
    A0 = Gm / gout
    As = ms_in.gm / (ms_in.gds + ms_ld.gds)
    Tdc = (A0 + As * mp.gm / gout) * beta
    a1 = -(Rf / R1) * Tdc / (1 + Tdc)
    cout = cl + mn.cdd + mp.cdd + 5e-15
    bw = (gout + beta * Gm) / (2 * PI * cout)
    power = vdd * (iref + Is + Im)
    return n, {"a1": a1, "a2": 0.0, "bw": bw, "vout_offset": 0.0,
               "power": power, "A0_db": db(A0)}
```
